```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-secrets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Validate secrets
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}" || -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}" || -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" || -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" || -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}" || -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" ]]; then
            echo "One or more required secrets are missing."
            exit 1
          fi

  bump-version:
    needs: validate-secrets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'
      - name: Bump version
        run: |
          mvn versions:set -DnewVersion=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }} -Prelease
          git add .
          git commit -m "Bump version to ${github.event.inputs.new_version}"
          git push origin ${{ github.ref }}
      - name: Create release commit
        run: |
          git checkout main
          git merge --ff-only ${{ github.ref }}
          git push origin main

  build-and-publish:
    needs: bump-version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mvn clean install -Prelease
      - name: Publish to Maven Central
        run: mvn deploy -Prelease
      - name: Build Docker image
        run: mvn jib:build -Prelease
      - name: Push Docker image
        run: docker login -u ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }} -p ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }} && docker push rrobetti/ojp:${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}

  update-documentation:
    needs: build-and-publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Update documentation
        run: |
          python scripts/update_documentation.py --version ${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}
      - name: Commit and push updates
        run: |
          git add documents/
          git commit -m "Update documentation for version ${github.event.inputs.new_version}"
          git push origin main
```
